name: week
title: The telecom operations week
subtitle: Read-only review. No carrier instructions are sent.

sections.title: Open service changes
sections.sql: select * from order_book order by due_on,code

sections.title: Carrier follow-ups
sections.sql: select * from carrier_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Renewals within 60 days or expired
sections.sql: select code,account,site,contract_end,days_to_expiry from renewal_queue order by contract_end

sections.title: Monthly margin by currency
sections.note: Contracted charge less recorded carrier cost. Excludes tax, usage, overhead and unrecorded charges. No currency conversion.
sections.sql: select * from monthly_margin order by currency,account

sections.title: Negative margin services
sections.sql: select code,account,currency,charge_cents,cost_cents,margin_cents from service_register where status='active' and margin_cents<0

sections.title: Accuracy, retention and carrier references
sections.note: Record checks support review; they do not certify legal compliance.
sections.sql: select * from record_checks order by code
